text: Code reviews are a vital part of modern software development. Instead of writing code alone, developers ask their teammates to examine their work before it is added to the main project. This practice helps catch bugs early, when they are much easier and cheaper to fix. Beyond finding mistakes, reviews are a powerful tool for knowledge sharing. Team members learn from each other’s techniques, coding styles, and solutions to tricky problems. Over time, this builds a stronger, more collaborative team where everyone takes responsibility for the final product. Simply put, good code reviews raise overall quality, reduce future headaches, and create a culture of continuous improvement.
